title: Shabbir Tera Matam
body:
matam karo shabbir ka haye zainab e dilgeer ka
shabbir tera matam momin ki nishani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bakshish ki zamanat hai jo aankh mein pani hai
shabbir tera matam momin ki nishani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye daagh nahi logon hai moajza matam ka
seene pe likhi mere karbal ki kahani hai
matam karo shabbir ka...
shabbir tera matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ka alam le ke bazaar mein aaye hai
rudaad aseeron ki dunya ko sunaani hai
matam karo shabbir ka...
shabbir tera matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne shuru ki thi zindan mein azadari
sadiyon se chali aayi ye reet purani hai
matam karo shabbir ka...
shabbir tera matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai sada ab bhi karbal ki fazaon se
shabbir haqeeqat mein islam ka baani hai
matam karo shabbir ka...
shabbir tera matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
de pursa bahattar ka zahra ke lute ghar ka
har saal moharram mein ye yaad dilaani hai
matam karo shabbir ka...
shabbir tera matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ke matam mein marna hi sa’adat hai
waise bhi jawaad ek din ye jaan to jaani hai
matam karo shabbir ka...
shabbir tera matam...
author: Jawad Jaffri
